This is a benign technical question about Rust crates — no harm-adjacent or distasteful content is involved. So the task-preference distinctions between the two models (which only matter for graphic/hostile/ethically fraught material) are irrelevant here.

That leaves raw capability as the deciding factor. Willet-235B outperforms Curlew-235B across every public benchmark (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 54.3, IFEval 89.8 vs 85.6, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4) and across the internal routing evals most relevant to a clear technical explanation with code examples. For a question that rewards accuracy and quality of explanation, Willet is the stronger choice.
